A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presence of primary tauopathy in the temporal lobe, as well as other factors, such as vascular disease, may be associated with dementia in individuals without amyloid plaques.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the PART phenotype is associated with less severe tauopathy and a more benign course.
